description: Create or update a named test run. Omit id to create (release required). Optional title, environment (server defaults QA), dueDate, status (ACTIVE|COMPLETED|ARCHIVED), batchInvocationIds, and commitRange: FIND (discover batches in the prior-release-cut to current-cut SHA range without attaching) or LINK (attach the unlinked ones). Response includes id, summary, created, link counts, commit SHAs, discoveredBatchInvocationIds and unlinkedBatchInvocationIds.
name: manage-test-run
title: Manage Test Run
